answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The quartz holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the yarrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
